info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Market Data By Param1-spec
info.description: The Market Data Retrieval API enables users to access specific market information based on provided parameters. This API is designed for financial analysts and developers who need to obtain market data for analysis, reporting, or visualization. By supplying the relevant parameter, users can fetch comprehensive market insights, helping inform trading strategies and investment decisions. This API supports various market-related queries, empowering organizations to leverage real-time data in their financial applications.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed market information using a specific resource ID. It provides essential data for analysis and decision-making in market management.
